hard_rules: E5-B submission state is independently revalidated and never trusted as publication proof
CorePackArtifact is distinct and immutable rather than a relabelled candidate
submission signature publication canary activation rollout rollback and runtime correctness remain independent
private signing authorization and deployment credentials never enter repository CLI fixtures logs or canonical results
publication creates PublishedInactive and never mutates current or default
fresh exact readback validation precedes canary or activation
canary cohorts and observations are exact bounded authorized and privacy reviewed
missing partial conflicted truncated or NotEvaluated required signals never pass
rollout has finite explicit stages and never advances from elapsed time or absence of complaints
activation uses exact profile specific current record compare and swap
last known good is explicitly designated and never inferred as previous or newest
rollback creates new immutable effect and closure records and never rewrites history
revocation deactivation and rollback remain distinct
project recognizer graph generations close stale producer partitions without mutating historical generations
response loss becomes OutcomeUnknown and blocks blind repeat
no public success before retention audit and reverse resource closure
E5-C internal publication is not public distribution
missing implementation signing authorization canary runtime benchmark or checksum evidence is blocked or NotEvaluated never pass

all publication artifact recognizer graph project store signing authorization canary observation rollout activation rollback revocation retention and audit port identities
all signing trust root algorithm key lifecycle provenance SBOM license notice and reproducibility profiles without private credentials
all canary population cohort privacy observation signal denominator rollout stage activation LKG rollback closure and emergency profiles
canonical artifact attestation signature publication current LKG rollback revocation closure envelope CLI and error vectors
synthetic and admitted real publication canary rollout rollback response-loss security and benchmark fixtures
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
